name: clarinet
description: A clarinet with a tapered reed mouthpiece, a long keyed tube and a flared bell.
useCase: Identify a clarinet or a single-reed woodwind part.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: The long diagonal tube and compact terminal bell keep the clarinet slender. Short key levers join one side of the tube, and a small rightward adjustment centers the silhouette.

24.reason: The long tube retains its tapered mouthpiece, compact keys and terminal bell. A small rightward and downward adjustment centers the diagonal silhouette.
